cards.title: Semimechanistic PK/PD Model Structure for Time-Kill Curves
cards.claim: The PK/PD model divides the bacterial population into two subpopulations: a growing drug-susceptible population (S) and a resting drug-insusceptible population (R). The transfer from S to R (k_SR) is proportional to the total bacterial concentration (S+R), modeling phenotypic switching to a persister state at high densities. The drug effect is modeled as an Emax function increasing the killing rate of the S population.
limitations: In vitro model; does not account for host immune response or in vivo PK variability
Assumes first-order degradation for unstable drugs
Effect delay modeled via link compartment
cards.downstream_use: Prediction of bacterial kill curves under various concentration-time profiles; comparison of antibiotic efficacy.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
